day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadkii 32-aad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada.
homily:
Bal ka fikir subax qabow, marka aad garoonka diyaaradaha taagan tahay, adigoo daawanaya diyaaradaha oo si tartiib ah u soo dagaya. Waxaa jira xasilooni ku jirta qofka garanaya in diyaaraddu ay leedahay waddo loo jeexay, xitaa marka daruuruhu ay adag yihiin. Waxaa jira wax aad u qurux badan oo ku saabsan sida ay diyaaraddu u raacdo tilmaamaha tower-ka, iyadoo kalsooni ku qabta in waddadu ay u furan tahay. Maanta, akhriska koowaad, Saint John wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ku saabsan inaan 'ku soconno runta'. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Jacaylku waa inaan ku soconno sidii uu inoo amray.' Waa casuumaad aan ahayn mid cusub, balse waa mid aan ka soo bilownay bilowgii: inaan is-jeclaanno. Waa waddo aan ku soconno, waddo aan ku kalsoonahay, xitaa marka aanan arkayn dhammaadka safarka.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay in nolosha ay u baahan tahay waddo cad iyo ujeeddo. Waxaad ogtihiin inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay u duulaysay sidii diyaaradaha uu aadka u jeclaa. Waxa uu ahaa wiil leh xigmad ka fog da'diisa, wiil ku faraxsan inuu barto DevOps iyo cloud infrastructure, laakiin waxaa ka sii qurux badnaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu waalidkiis la wadaago riyadiisa 'con chim airlines'. Markuu ka hadlayey shirkaddan yar ee uu ku riyoon jiray, wuxuu si tartiib ah u dhoola caddayn jiray, iyadoo indhihiisu ay ka buuxaan farxad nadiif ah. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil ku socday runta, wiil aan ka baqin inuu bixiyo waxa uu haysto. Waxaan xusuusanahay markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta ku jirtay si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, lacagtiisana lama bixin sababtoo ah waxaa jiray caymis, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba.

Laakiin maanta, Injiilka wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ku saabsan tukashada. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan 'u tukanno mar walba oo aynaan daalin.' Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheekada naagtii carmalka ahayd ee u tagtay garsooraha aan Ilaah ka cabsanayn. Naagtan ma aysan quusan. Waxay sii waday inay weydiisato caddaalad. Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan u adkaysanno tukashada, maxaa yeelay Ilaah wuxuu maqlayaa qaylada dadkiisa. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan u tukanno si aanan u daalin. Tukashadu ma aha oo kaliya codsi, waa wada sheekaysi jacayl. Waa markaad la hadlayso Aabbaha oo aad u sheegayso xanuunkaaga, rajadaada, iyo jacaylkaaga. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaanan cabsanin. Wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan hore u soconno. Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, oo xasuusanaya xiriirka adiga iyo Ben idin ka dhaxeeyay, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha horay u qaadaan, inaad ku raaxaysataan waxyaabaha yaryar ee quruxda badan, sababtoo ah Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada ciyaarayeen ama ay wada safrayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Sidee buu kanu hadda u taabanayaa qof kasta oo naga mid ah oo maanta halkan jooga? Adiga oo hooyo ah oo habeenkii ilmaynaysa, adiga oo aabbe ah oo xasuusanaya sheekooyinka uu Ben si dhab ah u dhagaysan jiray, adiga oo ah qof dareemaya inuu culaysku ka batay—ogow in Rabbigu uu kula socdo. Maanta, markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-eedeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad ku jirto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan u imow qalbigayga si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhowaynayaa sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana naftayda u midaynayaa adiga. Waligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhowro, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, u naxariiso Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan intii naga horreysay ee dhimatay, oo siiso inay ku nastaan iftiinkaaga weligeed ah.
Rabbiyow, u naxariiso dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, siiso rajo iyo nabad qalbigooda, oo ha dareemaan jacaylkaaga oo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Gacaliye, waxaad aaminnimo ku muujisay wax kasta oo aad u qabatid walaalaha, gaar ahaan shisheeyaha; waxay ka marag kaceen jacaylkaaga hortiisa kiniisadda. Fadlan ku caawi qaab u qalma Ilaah si ay safarkooda u sii wataan. Waayo, waxay u baxeen aawadiis Magaca, waxna kama qaataan dadka aan rumaysadka lahayn. Sidaas darteed, waa inaan taageernaa dadka noocaas ah, si aan u noqonno wada-shaqeeyayaal runta ah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada. Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada, oo aad ugu farxa amarradiisa. Farcankiisu wuxuu ku xoogaysan doonaa dhulka; qarniga toosan waa la barakayn doonaa. R. Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada. Maalka iyo qaninimadu waxay ku jiri doonaan gurigiisa; deeqsinimadiisu way waari doontaa weligeed. Iftiinku wuxuu u iftiimaa mugdiga dhexdiisa kuwa toosan; wuxuu yahay mid naxariis badan, raxmad leh, oo xaq ah. R. Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada. Wanaag baa u sugnaaday ninka naxariista leh oo wax amaahiya, oo arrimihiisa ku maamula xaqnimo; weligii ma dhaqaaqi doono; kii xaqqa ahaa wuxuu ahaan doonaa mid weligiis la xusuusto. R. Barakaysan yahay ninka Rabbiga ka cabsada.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii u sheegay masaal ku saabsan baahida ay u qabaan inay tukadaan mar walba iyagoon daalin. Wuxuu yidhi, 'Waxaa magaaladaas joogay garsoore aan Ilaah ka cabsanayn, dadkana aan ixtiraamin. Naag carmal ah oo magaaladaas joogtay ayaa u iman jirtay, waxayna ku odhan jirtay, 'Caddaalad iigu samee cadawgayga.' Muddo dheer garsoorihii wuu diiddanaa, laakiin ugu dambayntii wuxuu is yidhi, 'In kasta oo aanan Ilaah ka cabsanayn, dadkana aanan ixtiraamin, haddana naagtan carmalka ah dhibkayga awgiis, caddaalad baan u samayn doonaa si aanay ugu dambayntii iigu iman oo iigu dharbaaxin.' Rabbigu wuxuu yidhi, 'Fiiri waxa garsooraha aan xaqa ahayn leeyahay. Miyaanu Ilaah u caddayn doonin dadkiisa la doortay ee u qaylinaya habeen iyo maalin? Miyuu u daahi doonaa inuu ka jawaabo? Waxaan idin leeyahay, wuxuu u samayn doonaa caddaalad si degdeg ah. Laakiin markuu Wiilka Aadanuhu yimaado, ma heli doonaa iimaan dhulka?'

day: Saturday of the Thirty-second Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
